brief: Redesign the first screen of https://news.ycombinator.com so it reads faster and feels more desirable, keeping brand and copy.

judge.reason: This is the unchanged legacy HN page which preserves brand and copy but offers no redesign for faster reading, desirability, hierarchy, or polish.

diagnosis: Object-shape (LO) and motion (MT) areas are low: a text-first screen with no clear object silhouette
directives: Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion.
critique.prompt_block:
BRAIN CRITIQUE (TRIBE v2 predicted human cortex while looking at the last render; values are relative within this image):
- most driven regions: reward & value (OFC/vmPFC) +0.98, places & scenes (PPA/RSC) +0.79, cognitive control (dlPFC) +0.78; least: early vision (V1–V4) -1.03, object shape & motion (MT/LO) -2.10
- first-2s hook vs later: attention +0.65 → +0.59, visual drive -0.57 → -1.26
- areas the aesthetic head cites: ▼ L affect, conflict (a24) [aesthetic]; ▼ L reward value, liking (pOFC) [aesthetic]; ▲ early vision (V1–V4) mean [attention]; ▲ object shape & motion (MT/LO) mean [attention]
- diagnosis: Object-shape (LO) and motion (MT) areas are low: a text-first screen with no clear object silhouette
- DO NEXT (highest priority first): (1) Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion.

changes.directive: Add one dominant object silhouette or diagonal that implies motion
changes.change: Added tilted browser-card hero as dominant silhouette with stacked cards, orange diagonal motion band and animated floating upvote arrows

judge.reason: Bold orange system has energy but tilted cards, stickers and competing callouts fragment focus and slow scanning.

diagnosis: Object-shape (LO) and motion (MT) areas are low: a text-first screen with no clear object silhouette
Place areas (PPA/RSC) dominate: the background scene swallows the message
Reward circuit (OFC/vmPFC) is on but the appeal head is average: value is felt but what is good isn't legible
directives: Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion.
Simplify the environment: crop or blur the scene, put copy on a solid panel, let one subject own the frame.
Name the value explicitly next to what the eye lands on: one benefit line + price/offer under the hero, nothing else competing.
